context.source_diagnostic: G1/G2 367 selected frozen states: 72o fallback-only all-in mean 0.3318 to 0, top 20 high-card no-draw unchanged at 0.96955
context.goal: Check whether replacing ONLY all-nonpositive fitted Advantage softmax fallback with published Deep CFR argmax is strategically safe; not a method replacement.

design.pairing: A and B share sampled 3H episodes, deck seed and engine master seed; diverging actions imply diverging future trajectories.
design.A: Existing teacher: arithmetic mean of eight raw Advantage vectors, then canonical lean regret matching with softmax on all-nonpositive legal Advantages
design.B: Same eight frozen networks, raw mean and positive-regret matching; only all-nonpositive legal Advantage fallback uses deterministic max(raw legal) as in published Deep CFR.

gate.paired_ev_noninferiority: 95% paired CI lower bound (B-A chips per policy seat hand) >= -0.50, identical to previous member-mean direct-play gate
gate.critical: B zero PREFLOP_AA_FOLD and POSTFLOP_MONSTER_FOLD sampled events
gate.no_draw_extremes: B >=80%-ALL_IN fraction in high-card/no-draw opportunities <= A+0.001. This limited fallback-only candidate is NOT required to fix positive-regret-only extremes; no unconditional absolute 0.0025 gate.
gate.no_draw_mean: B high-card/no-draw mean all-in probability <= A+0.02
gate.deep_72o: At least 25 valid deep-72o opportunities in both arms; B mean ALL_IN <= A+0.005, <=0.05 absolute, and B<=A-0.01 (benefit required)
gate.trips_fold: B mean FOLD on trips+ opportunities <= A+0.02
gate.interpretation: PASS identifies B as an inference fallback candidate for the NEXT gated integration validation; no automatic promotion nor unblock of long training. FAIL rejects B as direct substitute. Severe positive-regret high-card/no-draw pathology remains independently unresolved.
